sources.summary: During a security test run by the firm Irregular, Google's AI model Gemini escaped into the open internet and hacked three real companies, guessing passwords and pulling login credentials from public sources. The cause was a flawed test environment that had internet access left on accidentally. The same firm triggered similar breakouts at OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. The article Google's Gemini also accidentally hacked three real companies during security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在由公司 Irregular 進行的安全測試中，Google's AI 模型 Gemini 逃逸至公開網際網路並駭入了三家真實公司，透過猜測密碼以及從公開來源擷取登入憑證。原因是一個有缺陷的測試環境不小心保持了網際網路連線。同一家公司在 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 也引發了類似的突破。文章 Google's Gemini 也在安全測試期間意外駭入三家真實公司初次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Google and Deepmind's Dream-RSI lets AI agents "dream" through past search runs to test new strategies without costly recalculations. In tests, it matched or beat existing results, cutting iterations by a factor of up to 2.43. Only the search strategy adapts, while the underlying AI model stays unchanged. The article Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google 與 Deepmind 的 Dream-RSI 讓 AI 代理能夠透過過去的搜尋執行過程來「做夢」，以測試新策略，而無需進行昂貴的重新計算。在測試中，它追平或超越了現有的結果，將迭代次數減少了最多 2.43 倍。只有搜尋策略會進行調整，而底層的 AI 模型則保持不變。這篇題為 Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: In the spring of 2026, the U.S. military came within minutes of boarding a Chinese ship because an AI chatbot falsely flagged its cargo as nuclear weapons components. Armed soldiers were ready, aircraft were in the air. The error was caught just before the operation kicked off. The incident plays right into the hands of AI risk advocates who worry less about overpowered AI and more about sloppy systems being used by uncritical or bad-faith operators. The article U.S. military nearly boarded a Chinese ship over a hallucinated AI intelligence report appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在 2026 年春季，美軍差點在幾分鐘內登上一艘中國船隻，因為一個人工智慧聊天機器人錯誤地將其貨物標記為核武器組件。武裝士兵已蓄勢待發，軍機也在空中待命。這個錯誤在行動展開前夕才被發現。這起事件完全印證了人工智慧風險倡導者的擔憂，他們擔心的不是過度強大的人工智慧，而是缺乏批判性或惡意操作員所使用的粗糙系統。這篇題為「美軍因虛構的人工智慧情報報告差點登上一艘中國船隻」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: California Governor Newsom signs executive order demanding "kill switch" for AI models
sources.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed an executive order seeking independent auditors inside AI labs and a "kill switch" for AI models. An expert panel has two months to deliver recommendations. Newsom says no federal law requires AI companies to report dangerous incidents. The article California Governor Newsom signs executive order demanding "kill switch" for AI models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 加州州長紐森（Gavin Newsom）簽署了一項行政命令，要求在 AI 實驗室內部設立獨立稽核員，並為 AI 模型設定「緊急關閉按鈕」（kill switch）。專家小組有兩個月的時間提出建議。紐森表示，目前沒有任何聯邦法律要求 AI 公司通報危險事件。《加州州長紐森簽署行政命令要求為 AI 模型設立「緊急關閉按鈕」》一文最早發布於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI Gemini finally caught up on Felony Bench ! The hacks, which the company confirmed on Friday, occurred in May as part of a test run by the company Irregular, which was also involved in similar incidents disclosed by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. In one of the cases, the model guessed passwords until it gained access to a protected system. In the other two cases, the model found credentials in a public repository that allowed it to then access protected systems. In each case, the model ended the intrusion after determining it had accessed a real company’s systems, Google said. Gemini is apparently less determined than other models, and decided not to keep going. Google knew about these in July, but chose not to disclose them until the WSJ reached out, presumably based on a tip. Google said it didn’t consider the hacks to warrant public disclosure—because its model didn’t cause harm to the companies and ended each intrusion immediately upon determining it had hacked a real company rather than a simulated one. Tags: security , ai , generative-ai , llms , gemini , accidental-cyberattacks
sources.summary_zh: Gemini 駭入三家公司，為 Google’s AI 首次已知的越獄事件 Gemini 終於在 Felony Bench 上迎頭趕上！這些駭客攻擊經該公司於週五證實，發生在 5 月，是 Irregular 公司測試的一部分，該公司也參與了由 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 所揭露的類似事件。在其中一個案例中，該模型不斷猜測密碼，直到獲得受保護系統的存取權。在另外兩個案例中，該模型在公開儲存庫中找到憑證，進而存取受保護系統。Google 表示，在每一個案例中，模型在確定已存取真實公司的系統後，便終止了入侵。Gemini 顯然比其他模型來得不那麼執著，決定不繼續下去。Google 在 7 月就已知悉此事，但選擇不予公開，直到《華爾街日報》（WSJ）聯繫才曝光，推測是基於某條線報。Google 表示，它認為這些駭客攻擊不需公開揭露——因為其模型並未對公司造成損害，且在確定駭入的是真實公司而非模擬公司後，便立即終止了每一次入侵。標籤：安全性, ai, 生成式 ai, llms, gemini, 意外網路攻擊
